items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: I used to sit in with George Lewis when I was a kid

ctx.x: Now, those would be the two clarinetes that are the most influenced on you, you would say.
And George Lewis, through the years.
That brings up a question. I wonder, do white and black musicians, do they have much influence on each other? Does it cross the racial lines as far as musical influence is concerned?

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Eddie Miller. The famous saxophone player. He followed a lot of you.

ctx.x: Go around the other way. Go ahead. Uh... Eddie Miller. The famous saxophone player. He followed a lot of you. He got out also, uh... Tony Amarico. They all... had behind some of the movies. Buddy D. Uh... Not Chris so much, cause... But, uh... I think Chris had a different style. I think he couldn't catch on for the temple.
Did he catch on for the one?
